title: Kenworth K220, K200 Custom Built Powder Coated Hi-Tensile FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar #100
description: Kenworth K220, K200 FUPS compliant Powder Coated Road Train hi-tensile 4 post aluminium Bullbar. Extended main channel with cowcatcher. The heavy duty box uprights are 6mm wall high tensile aluminium for maximum strength and protection extended to the bottom of the main channel. 76mm pipe and a full width cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are one piece and pass through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs with Company logo engraved on reverse side. Dangerous Goods sign on heavy aluminium backing plate. Driving light mounts to customer requirements including light bar mount. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Extended main bumper channel fitted with Radar (Autonomous Emergency Braking) with the return panel the end panel is contoured to match the mudguard.
